task.title: Tighten roleplay memory retrieval and greeting deduplication
task.source: Live Pi roleplay prompt snapshot showed weak unrelated Character Memories and the active alternate greeting injected beside identical chat history.
task.classification: prompt assembly and memory relevance change

coreClaim: Roleplay prompts reject weak cross-chat Character Memory matches and do not reinject a greeting already present in visible history after macro expansion.
rootCause: Character scope, confidence, and recency inflated weak semantic or low-coverage lexical matches, while behavioral-example history comparison expanded macros only on the candidate side.

outOfScope: Memory capture or stored memory text
Character cards, lorebooks, or existing chat history

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Only prompt admission and behavioral-example overlap comparison change; canonical records and authored card fields remain untouched.
entrypoints: Conversation and Roleplay canonical-memory prompt assembly
outOfScopeClaims: No claim that all embedding providers assign identical scores.
No stored memory, greeting, card, lorebook, or transcript migration.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Cross-chat Character Memories could enter a prompt from weak semantic or low-coverage generic lexical evidence, and the same greeting could enter as history plus a behavioral example when macro forms differed.
contractLaneGate.producer: Canonical memory retrieval and authored character greeting fields provide candidate context.
contractLaneGate.consumer: The TypeScript generation engine selects canonical memory and behavioral-example prompt blocks.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Prompt assembly admits context only when it is relevant and non-duplicative without mutating or replaying transcript content.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Cross-chat character candidates require strong semantic similarity or at least half of meaningful query tokens; behavioral candidates compare both raw and safely resolved candidate forms against untouched raw history.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: src/engine/generation owns canonical-memory ranking and behavioral-example selection.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not rewrite stored memories or greetings, disable Memory Recall globally, mutate history, or patch the Roleplay UI around polluted prompts.
regressionProof: canonical-memory-context.spec.ts covers weak semantic, low lexical coverage, strong paraphrase, pinned, and local continuity rows.
behavioral-example-pool.spec.ts and prompt-assembly.behavioral-examples.spec.ts cover raw/resolved greeting overlap without running history macros.

riskClaimMatrix.coreClaim: Cross-chat character memories require strong semantic relevance or meaningful lexical query coverage.
entrypoints: Conversation and Roleplay canonical-memory prompt assembly
currentPathsOrFormats: canonical-memories records and canonical_memories prompt block
negativeRowsTested: one generic word across a longer query
two generic words across a longer query
groundTruthFacts: Canonical records remain unchanged; only prompt admission changes.
riskClaimMatrix.userActionCopy: No user action or data migration is required.

riskClaimMatrix.coreClaim: A greeting already visible in history is excluded even when user and character macros occur inside narration.
legacyPathsOrFormats: Authored dialogue examples not present in history remain eligible.
negativeRowsTested: Visible alternate greeting with {{user}} inside narration
groundTruthFacts: Raw and resolved candidate forms are compared against raw history without executing history macros.

positiveRows.claim: Strong semantic paraphrases and relevant local continuity still enter canonical memory context.
positiveRows.evidence: canonical-memory-context.spec.ts passes the 0.86 paraphrase, lexical fallback, pinned, chat-local, and scene-local cases.

positiveRows.claim: A distinct authored behavioral example remains selectable.
positiveRows.evidence: behavioral-example-pool.spec.ts and prompt-assembly.behavioral-examples.spec.ts retain relevant non-overlapping authored examples.

contradictionRows.claim: Weak 0.31-0.32 cross-chat semantic candidates must not enter the prompt.
contradictionRows.evidence: canonical-memory-context.spec.ts returns null for the live roleplay query shape.

contradictionRows.claim: One or two generic overlapping words in a longer cross-chat turn must not qualify a Character Memory.
contradictionRows.evidence: canonical-memory-context.spec.ts covers both low-coverage negative controls.

contradictionRows.claim: The active greeting must not appear as both history and a behavioral example.
contradictionRows.evidence: prompt-assembly.behavioral-examples.spec.ts marks the alternate greeting history_overlap when {{user}} occurs inside narration.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Pinned and relevant chat/scene-local memories preserve their prior eligibility.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: All canonical-memory-context and end-to-end memory recall suites pass.

untestedRows: Provider-specific similarity distributions remain a live quality observation after deployment; deterministic admission boundaries are covered locally.
